The joint bound is what the share carves at once in VMs: in_flight = floor(share_pages / min(sizes.session.pages, sizes.agent.pages)) + 1 (3Q's spare; processes could only tighten it, so pages alone is the stated upper bound). `state` keeps F2's sum (cheap, conservative: two connections per session at erofsd). Image alice: 40,959 / 5,248 -> 7 + 1 = 8 (now 6); the latency alice at N = 16: 95,361 / 5,248 -> 18 + 1 = 19, 10 x 19 = 190 <= 192; six-principals unchanged; N = 16 reached. Add one bench assertion guarding R4a across the tree: for every manifest and every server, the sum of in_flight over its buckets (defaults and overrides both) <= MAX_OPEN_CALLS - OPEN_CALL_HEADROOM, so a manifest past it fails the bench, never Unsized at boot. Not (a): it would record N = 12 for a wall that is the double-counting; not (b): a manifest tuned to a case. Pages: walfsd.md's and littlefsd.md's derivation gain the in_flight form with the image's arithmetic; serving.md 'admit' one clause; ipc.md R4a unchanged (cite its headroom).
